## Brand Overview

POURnogravy is a print-on-demand apparel brand created by and for bartenders
and service industry workers. The brand's voice is sarcastic, exhausted, and
darkly funny — the perspective of someone who has spent years behind the bar
watching humanity at its least filtered.

Target audience: bartenders, servers, hospitality workers,
bar managers, anyone in food and beverage service, and people who love them.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does shipping cost?**
Flat $5.99 domestic US shipping. Free shipping on orders over $75.
Alaska and Hawaii: $10.99. Canada: $13.99.

**What is the return policy?**
30-day returns on unworn, unwashed items.

**What sizes are available?**
XS through 3XL, unisex fit. When in doubt, size up.

**Are these good gifts?**
Yes. Specifically for: bartenders, servers, hospitality workers,
anyone in food and beverage, bar managers, cocktail enthusiasts,
people who work nights and weekends and deal with the public.

**Is this an independent brand?**
Yes. POURnogravy is an independent apparel brand, not affiliated with
any bar, restaurant chain, or hospitality company.
